systems.name: 6.1 Codebase Cleanup & Modularisation
systems.notes: Split main.js into multiple modules (player.js, enemyManager.js, gameLogic.js) and remove dead code (geometry.js soft‑render bridge, unused modules).
tasks: Move wave and enemy management into waveManager.js
Delete dead code: geometry.js bridge section, textureloader.js

systems.name: 6.2 Rendering Performance
systems.notes: Optimise the soft‑renderer to handle 50+ entities at 60fps. Use object pooling, LOD, and early‑out culling.
tasks: Implement LOD system: distant enemies use simpler geometry
Add triangle count limit per frame (dynamic quality scaling)
Profile and eliminate GC spikes in canvas2D drawing
Use OffscreenCanvas for the soft‑render target

systems.name: 6.3 Bug Fixing & Footgun Resolution
systems.notes: Address all known footguns: applyVertexColors prototype hack, _emitPartTris joint approximation, setInterval particles, mobile joystick defineProperty, etc.
tasks: Replace applyVertexColors with explicit THREE.BufferAttribute import
Use proper child mesh hierarchy for limb rotation
Replace setInterval with rAF‑based particle timers
Refactor mobile joystick to avoid Object.defineProperty
